{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# C8 LLaMA n=250: 8 conditions across 4 GPUs
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/autodl-tmp/pacs

MODEL="checkpoints/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B"
DATA="data/math500.json"
N=250
TOKENS=8192
MPL=10

run_condition() {
    local gpu=$1 method=$2 sparsity=$3
    local sp_str=$(python3 -c "print(f's{int(float(\"$sparsity\")*100):03d}')")
    local outdir="profiling_output_c8_llama_${method}_${sp_str}"
    local logfile="logs/c8_llama_${method}_${sp_str}.log"

    if [ -f "$outdir/profiling_results.json" ]; then
        echo "SKIP: $outdir already exists"
        return 0
    fi

    echo "$(date) START: gpu=$gpu method=$method sparsity=$sparsity -> $outdir"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python -m pacs.profiling.run_profiling \
        --model_path "$MODEL" \
        --data_path "$DATA" \
        --output_dir "./$outdir" \
        --sparsity_levels "$sparsity" \
        --masking_method "$method" \
        --max_new_tokens $TOKENS \
        --min_phase_length $MPL \
        --max_problems $N \
        --save_generations \
        2>&1 | tee "$logfile"
    echo "$(date) DONE: $outdir"
}

mkdir -p logs

# GPU 0: importance s015 + s020
(
    run_condition 0 importance 0.15
    run_condition 0 importance 0.20
    echo "$(date) GPU0 ALL DONE"
) &
PID_GPU0=$!

# GPU 1: importance s025 + s030
(
    run_condition 1 importance 0.25
    run_condition 1 importance 0.30
    echo "$(date) GPU1 ALL DONE"
) &
PID_GPU1=$!

# GPU 2: random s015 + s020
(
    run_condition 2 random 0.15
    run_condition 2 random 0.20
    echo "$(date) GPU2 ALL DONE"
) &
PID_GPU2=$!

# GPU 3: random s025 + s030
(
    run_condition 3 random 0.25
    run_condition 3 random 0.30
    echo "$(date) GPU3 ALL DONE"
) &
PID_GPU3=$!

echo "PIDs: GPU0=$PID_GPU0 GPU1=$PID_GPU1 GPU2=$PID_GPU2 GPU3=$PID_GPU3"
wait $PID_GPU0 $PID_GPU1 $PID_GPU2 $PID_GPU3
echo "$(date) ALL C8 LLAMA N250 EXPERIMENTS COMPLETE"
